description: This file configures an axios HTTP client instance for API communication in a frontend application, including environment-based base URL, request interceptors for attaching auth tokens, and response interceptors for error handling.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates an axios HTTP client instance with specified configuration.

methods.name: http.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to attach authorization header if token exists.

methods.name: http.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor for handling errors such as unauthorized access.
